# Evidence
- Problem class: go-ring-allreduce-hierarchical-reduce-scatter-bf16-drift
- Model: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash
- Solved: 2026-11-02T09:35:30.943Z
- Verification: solution produced by pi in sandbox; see signatures.json

signatures.description: Implement a hierarchical (intra-node shared-memory, inter-node ring) reduce-scatter + all-gather for a 4 GiB fp32 gradient buffer that is compressed to bf16 on the wire; the existing flat ring buffer variant deadlocks whenever world size is not a power of two (chunks of unequal size are never sent) and produces rank-divergent weights because bf16 up-conversion is applied per hop instead of once at the source. Acceptance: bitwise-identical parameter hashes on all ranks after 50 synthetic steps for world sizes 3, 5, 7 and 8; numeric delta versus a single-node reference under 1e-5 relative L2; no goroutine left blocked after a peer is killed mid-round (stall detector must fire within 2s instead of hanging); peak RSS under 1.5x the uncompressed buffer.
